t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Making the Grade
d: Sabrina tries to right a wrong when she writes an article for the school paper exposing the preferential treatment given to school athletes, but she inadvertently puts Roxie's scholarship in jeopardy.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
st: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
d: Sabrina agrees to a double date on Valentine's Day with Josh and Morgan, but by the end of the date she finds herself in the middle of her friends' break up.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Muse
d: Sabrina is flattered when her new boyfriend writes music about his feelings for her, but the pressure to inspire him as his muse becomes a one-sided relationship.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Beach Blanket Bizarro
d: Sabrina’s wild visions of her first college spring break turn squeaky-clean when her aunts ask 60’s teen idol Frankie Avalon to put a spell on the trip. This sends Sabrina and her friends into a world straight out of a 60’s beach movie.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Witchright Hall
d: When Sabrina’s trouble-making teenage cousin Amanda is sent to live with Hilda and Zelda, they count on Sabrina to convince the headmaster and school director of Witchright Hall to accept Amanda.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Activist
d: Sabrina, who is now in low spirits over her heavy course load and recent break up, decides to put her energy into something positive: leading a protest to save an historical building from demolition.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Do You See What I See?
st: Do You See What I See?
d: Sabrina feels responsible when Miles considers giving up his paranormal research to settle in his father’s accounting business after no one believes the otherworldly phenomena he sees at the Spellman home.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Got Spirit
d: Sabrina tries to throw off Miles and the specialist he has hired to uncover paranormal activity in the house, but Sabrina herself discovers a ghost in the ceiling.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Finally!
d: Romance brews between Sabrina and Josh when they turn the coffeehouse into a single's night featuring entertainment by the band Eden's Crush.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Really Big Season Opener
d: Miles decides to make a student film in his favorite genre, horror, and enlists Sabrina as the producer of his film.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Date with Destiny
d: Sabrina and her friends return to school and a lot of excitement after summer break.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: What’s News?
d: Josh lands a job as a photojournalist for the Boston Citizen, and is surprised to learn that Sabrina is a fan of his new boss, Mike Shelby.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Murder on the Halloween Express
d: Hilda and Zelda are invited to attend a murder mystery party on the Halloween Mystery Train, which makes a stop in Boston.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Gift of Gab
d: Sabrina and Roxie are thrilled to get their own show on the campus radio station, a two hour talk show they call "Chick Chat."

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Thin Ice
d: Sabrina finds herself in a jam when ex-boyfriend Harvey requests that she use her magical powers to help him.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Hex, Lies, and No Videotape
d: Josh gets Sabrina an internship at the Boston Citizen where he works.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Humble Pie
d: Sabrina and her roommates discover that Morgan didn't pay her portion of the rent when the housing office sends a student to replace her in the house.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: A Birthday Witch
d: Sabrina receives an unexpected surprise on her birthday, a visit from her evil Aunt Irms, the matriarch of the Spellman family.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Deliver Us from Email
d: Intern Sabrina wants to propose writing her own column about the college experience to Boston Citizen editor Mike Shelby.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Cloud Ten
d: In an attempt to escape her problems, Sabrina decides to visit her childhood friend, Cathy Winter (Colleen Ann Fitzpatrick) in the Other Realm.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina and the Candidate
d: Sabrina is assigned to research the local city councilman election for an article, which will run in the Boston Citizen.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: I Think I Love You
d: Sabrina's relationship with Josh couldn't be going better until Josh tells her that he loves her.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Arrangement
d: Sabrina's devilish Aunt Irma returns for yet another unexpected visit.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Time After Time
d: When Zelda's boyfriend breaks up with her she cooks up a storm to drown her sorrows.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina and the Kiss
d: Sabrina gets an unexpected surprise when ex-boyfriend Derek stops by to say hello.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Competition
d: A friendly game of tennis turns into a battle of the sexes when Josh tells Sabrina that women are not as competitive as men.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: I, Busybody
d: Always willing to help others with their problems, whether they ask for it or not, Sabrina finds herself in a heap of trouble when her advice goes awry.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Guilty
d: When Sabrina uses a little magic to get Zelda nominated for an award, she has no idea what she's started.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Whole Ball of Wax
d: When Sabrina gets an eerie feeling that she is being followed, she decides to take matters into her own hands but ends up face-to-face with her mother Diana.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Driving Mr. Goodman
d: Sabrina persuades Miles Goodman to get his driver's license and finds herself in the middle of a nasty lawsuit.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: I Fall to Pieces
d: When Hilda's boyfriend breaks up with her, she is devastated and claims that she is through with men.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Total Sabrina Live
d: Sabrina’s search for a job takes her to NYC and the Mtelevision studios.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Big Head
d: Sabrina has to write about an obnoxious pop star, who threatens to sue the magazine unless she apologises! Plus, Roxie and Morgan try to train Salem.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Call Me Crazy
d: Sabrina tries to impress her colleagues but accidentally says far too much about her magical life, making everyone think that she's totally crazy.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Shift Happens
d: Sabrina is worried about having to interview a hip-hop star, but a spell to make them nicer backfires, and causes the pair to switch personalities.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Free Sabrina
d: Reporter Sabrina follows a story and almost lands herself in jail.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina Unplugged
d: Sabrina encounters animated Shaggy and Scooby Doo inside Leonard's computer while trying to destroy proof of her powers.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Witch Way Out
d: Sabrina meets a gallery owner (guest star Austin Peck) who already possesses a leprechaun (guest star Verne Troyer) and wants a witch to round out his collection.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Bada-Ping
d: Sabrina believes a musician (guest star Richard Voll) is being blackmailed by a gangster (guest star Garry Marshall); Avril Lavigne (guest starring as herself) performs. Emily Hart also guest stars.

t: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: It's a Hot, Hot, Hot, Hot Christmas
st: It's a Hot, Hot, Hot, Hot Christmas
d: The girls spend Christmas in Miami where Roxie runs into her ex-con mom.
